content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-downloads-pakistan-first-principles-definitive-breakdown|Selling Digital]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-everything-you-need|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-trap-most-creators|payment]] layer is where everything breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Implementing a sovereign digital commerce stack is a paradigm shift from relying on third-party platforms like Gumroad, which charge 10% on every sale. By using NOWPayments, a 0.5% fee is incurred, resulting in a significant cost savings at scale. This architecture empowers digital creators to own their infrastructure, eliminating platform fees and data ownership concerns. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component plays a crucial role in ensuring seamless digital commerce operations. By using Cloudflare Workers, for instance, creators can automate delivery of digital products, eliminating manual intervention and reducing latency.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators who sell ebooks, templates, software, and other digital products but face challenges with platform restrictions. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can access new revenue streams, expand their customer base, and build a sustainable business model. With the Complete Builder Kit, creators can deploy a fully functional online store with ease, without relying on third-party platforms.
By implementing a sovereign digital commerce stack, digital creators can eliminate platform fees and retain full control over their data and infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. By integrating these components, creators can ensure seamless digital commerce operations, eliminate platform fees, and retain full control over their data and infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.

For digital creators who want to sell ebooks, templates, and software without relying on third-party platforms, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive solution. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to shop and download the Complete Builder Kit.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: acquire the Complete Builder Kit ($197), choose a hosting platform (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and enable NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Upon completion, test your stack to ensure seamless digital commerce operations.
Frequently Asked Questions

To integrate NOWPayments, follow the instructions provided in the Complete Builder Kit, which includes a NOWPayments integration guide. This guide will walk you through the process of setting up automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring seamless digital commerce operations.
Can I use multiple cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments?

Yes, NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments in various digital assets and expand your customer base. With NOWPayments, you can also configure automatic cryptocurrency pricing in USD, ensuring a seamless user experience.
How do I ensure data ownership and security in my digital commerce stack?

To ensure data ownership and security, use a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. These tools provide a secure and decentralized infrastructure, eliminating data ownership concerns and ensuring seamless digital commerce operations.
Can I automate delivery of digital products?

Yes, by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate delivery of digital products, eliminating manual intervention and reducing latency. This ensures a seamless user experience and increases customer satisfaction.
